reference_sql:
SELECT promo_id, promo_code
FROM promotions
WHERE promo_id IN (
  SELECT pp.promo_id
  FROM promotion_products pp
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id
  WHERE p.brand = 'Sonora'
)
alternatives:
SELECT pr.promo_id, pr.promo_code
FROM promotions pr
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM promotion_products pp
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id
  WHERE pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
    AND p.brand = 'Sonora'
)

SELECT DISTINCT pr.promo_id, pr.promo_code
FROM promotions pr
JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id
WHERE p.brand = 'Sonora'

other_way.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT pr.promo_id, pr.promo_code
FROM promotions pr
JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = pr.promo_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = pp.product_id
WHERE p.brand = 'Sonora'
other_way.tradeoff: Joining the three tables with DISTINCT gives the same list, but IN never repeats a promotion in the first place.
